youtube.title: Credit Card Ka 'Minimum Due': Sabse Mehenga Button #Shorts
youtube.description:
Credit card ka sirf minimum due bharna kyun itna mehenga hai? Zyaadatar Indian cards 3.75% mahina (kareeb 45% saal) tak interest lete hain. ₹1 lakh bill par sirf 5% minimum bharo, toh 12 mahine baad ~₹57,600 bhar ke bhi ~₹84,000 baaki.
मिनिमम ड्यू बस लेट फ़ीस से बचाता है, कर्ज़ ख़त्म नहीं करता।

Is video ke numbers:
• Card finance charges up to 3.75% a month / ~45% a year: ICICI Bank credit card interest-rate page; SBI Card, HDFC Bank, Axis Bank list up to 3.75% a month (2026)
• Example: ₹1,00,000 balance, 3.75% monthly interest, 5% minimum har mahine (sirf example; GST aur fees ise aur bura banate hain; terms bank ke hisaab se alag)
• Balance carry karne par nayi khareedari ka interest-free period aam taur pe nahi milta (apne card ka MITC dekho)

Aap har mahine total due bharte ho? 👇

📌 Sirf educational content. SEBI-registered nahi. Investment advice nahi.
